IDENTITY: codex-storyatlas-root. The two-file Intaglio SurfaceUnit lowering remains intact, diff-check clean, and protected by renewed reservation rv-01M16QZ66VJCNT4F26A91JD7ZF. Earlier exact seam evidence against f390700 remains provisional: the provider is recutting the chief-required F2 typed refusal and mutation court.

Read-only preflight of the provider's newest committed branch tip found its F2 API but also a stale SurfaceRail channel rename that conflicts with the accepted owner disposition to retain VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit and strengthen its no-y/layout-only legend. I have reported that conflict to the provider and shared architecture board. No StoryAtlas pin or commit will be made against an unpublished or chief-blocked provider SHA. Once a corrected candidate is posted and accepted, I will run focused JVM/JS plus the full StoryAtlas exact-pin gate, then commit only the coherent build pin plus the two reserved lowering paths.
